g.text: Transfer the whole joint action and its comparisons
Finite formulas on every original parameter word

A = (1 + hΔ)⁻¹ B = (1 + Δh)⁻¹
I′ = A I P′ = P B H′ = A H
D_Y = d_Y + P Δ A I
At most q + 1 terms on a q-letter word.
All full coactions and special contraction identities survive.

δM₀₁₂ = M₀₂ − M₁₂ M₀₁
M_βγ and M_γβ have full inverse homotopies.

d(c) = b d(a) = d(b) = 0
